item.title: 'The View' hosts ask Rahm Emanuel if Trump started Iran war to distract from Epstein
item.summary: Iran war news dominates "The View" as Rahm Emanuel argues Trump made a "bad choice," warning the U.S. lacks a plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz if Iran does not comply.

item.title: Police hunt armed suspect after housekeeper bound, attacked in luxury mansion heist: report
item.summary: An armed suspect allegedly tied up a housekeeper at a $20 million Beverly mansion, with homeowner Thomas Swan III calling the ordeal "horrendous."

item.title: Super Bowl heading back to Las Vegas as NFL confirms 2029 site
item.summary: The NFL has officially awarded Las Vegas Super Bowl LXIII in 2029, with Allegiant Stadium set to host the big game for the second time in five years.

item.title: PHOTOS: Anti-ICE agitators dox agents by sending warning postcards to neighbors
item.summary: DHS says anti-ICE activists are doxxing immigration agents by mailing warning postcards to neighbors, adding to an alleged 8,000% surge in death threats.

item.title: Trump floats dragging Congress back during spring recess to end shutdown — but one hurdle stands in the way
item.summary: Trump says calling Congress back from Easter recess to end the record 45-day DHS shutdown is under consideration, but a GOP insider calls it unlikely.

item.title: 'Forrest Gump' star Gary Sinise warns many Americans are 'disconnected' from military service
item.summary: Actor Gary Sinise warns many Americans are disconnected from military service because they don't personally know anyone who serves, adding that gap threatens appreciation for troops.

item.title: Illegal alien murder suspect avoided system as ICE pushes Dem governor to keep him locked up
item.summary: A Guatemalan national illegally in the U.S. faces a murder charge in a Fairfax County stabbing, with ICE lodging a detainer and urging Virginia not to release him.

item.title: Kristi Noem, Trump respond to shocking cross-dressing photos tied to her husband
item.summary: Photos allegedly showing Kristi Noem's husband Bryon Noem cross-dressing in private messages to women have emerged.

item.title: Aggressive brain cancer may respond to high-dose vitamin therapy, study suggests
item.summary: High-dose vitamin B3 (niacin) may boost immune function and slow glioblastoma progression, with 82% of trial patients showing no disease progression after six months.

item.title: Federal judge revokes US citizenship of Chinese couple convicted of stealing medical trade secrets for China
item.summary: A married Chinese couple had their U.S. citizenship revoked after being convicted of stealing trade secrets from an Ohio children's hospital to share with China.
